children: Bahrain-based alternative investment firm Arcapita Group Holdings plans to invest $1.5 billion in industrial and logistics real estate across the GCC over the next 24 months.
The investment will build on Arcapita’s existing portfolio of more than $2 billion in assets under management in the sector, the company said on Monday.

The investment programme will focus on the development and acquisition of industrial and logistics assets across key GCC markets, with a particular emphasis on build-to-suit projects tailored to the operational needs of regional and international occupiers.
The strategy will be supported by Lintara Properties, Arcapita’s dedicated industrial and logistics real estate development and asset management platform.
(Writing by Brinda Darasha; editing by Daniel Luiz)

title: Bahrain's Arcapita plans to invest $1.5bln in GCC industrial, logistics assets
